## Required Checks
- [ ] `npm run validate` passed locally.
- [ ] Local mirror readiness has `errors=0` and `warnings=0`.
- [ ] GitHub Actions `Preview QA` passed.
- [ ] Target pages moved to `agent-approved-clean` or are explicitly marked `source-needed`.
- [ ] No `href="#"`, `.txt` href, local disk path, `pending`, `placeholder`, or internal work note appears in public-facing HTML.
- [ ] Product spec tables use real `<table>` elements with units where source data provides units.
- [ ] Accordion controls expose visible expand/collapse text plus `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`.
- [ ] PDF / CAD / Manual / Catalog / Drawing / Software links are classified clearly.
- [ ] CTA is visible and uses the existing inquiry/contact flow, or the limitation is documented.

## SEO / UIUX Checks
- [ ] One H1 per page is preserved.
- [ ] Canonical, title, meta description, breadcrumb, and internal links are not broken.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile samples were checked.
- [ ] No horizontal overflow, broken image, or unreadable table in sampled pages.
